relatedSnapshot.title: Charged twice for the same domain and inbox bundle; one bundle was never delivered and its subscription is still billing
relatedSnapshot.description:
Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

Conversation context: customer-initiated Intercom conversation, opened 2026-09-30, contact Name 1 <email>, workspace "Name 2 Workspace", owner role. Initial message: "I have a billing issue that isn't being sorted. Please escalate to someone asap!" Asked for detail: "I've been billed twice for emails and domains for the last 3 months when that's not what I'm using." Declined the self-serve answer: "No, I still need help." No attachments.

Bucket: overcharged.

Finding: the customer bought the same DFY bundle (1 domain + 3 inboxes) twice about 17 hours apart and was charged for both; only one bundle was ever delivered. Order <uuid> (domain <domain>, created 2026-07-23 14:01Z) was cancelled for "Payment timeout - order automatically cancelled after 30 minutes" with nothing provisioned, but its Autumn subscription and its Stripe charges landed anyway. Order <uuid> (domain <domain>, created 2026-07-24 06:47Z) completed and is the bundle the customer actually uses (3 active connected inboxes). The cancelled order's subscription was never cancelled, so it has kept invoicing every month since.

Exposure (Stripe, smallest currency unit, all succeeded and unrefunded, no credit notes):

* 2026-07-23, 3276 cents ($32.76), charge <stripe-id>, invoice EKGUJ5YE-0017
* 2026-08-23, 1800 cents ($18.00), charge <stripe-id>, invoice EKGUJ5YE-0021
* 2026-09-23, 1800 cents ($18.00), charge <stripe-id>, invoice EKGUJ5YE-0025
  Total already collected for the undelivered bundle: $68.76, and $18.00/month continues until the orphan subscription is cancelled. The delivered bundle's own charges are legitimate and are not part of this ask.

Proposed human action (proposal, not a promise): refund the $68.76 collected for the undelivered bundle, and cancel the orphan domain and inbox line items on the billing account so the recurring $18.00/month stops. A Stripe customer credit is the alternative if the customer would rather have it applied forward (the Legacy Pro plan bills monthly, so there is a future invoice to consume it). The customer has not yet said which they want. No money has been moved and nothing has been cancelled.

Full readout, systems of record, and the code path are in the Billing investigation document on this ticket.

relatedSnapshot.title: Pro subscription lapsed after failed Link renewal; domain and inbox add-ons remain active and billed
relatedSnapshot.description:
Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

Customer: Name 5 (<email>) — workspace "Name 5's Workspace".

Customer reported their Acquisity account shows "disabled" and the cold email engine stopped, while their card is still active and inboxes/domains still appear active.

Finding (verified against PlanetScale, Autumn, and Stripe):

* The Pro subscription ($185/month) — the core plan that keeps the cold email engine enabled — was auto-canceled by Stripe after 9 consecutive failed renewal attempts.
* The payment method on file was Stripe Link, and the Link connection was closed ("The connection to the user's Link account has been closed"), so every renewal attempt failed.
* The domain and inbox add-ons are billed on a separate Stripe subscription that is still active, which is why those charges continue while the core product is disabled.

Unblock:

* Customer needs to add a valid payment method and re-subscribe to Pro to re-enable the engine.
* A human should review the still-active domain/inbox add-on charges (inboxes ~$144/month) and decide whether to pause or credit them while the core plan is inactive.

Classification: Platform Limitation (expected auto-cancel on payment failure), not a bug.

relatedSnapshot.title: Refund requested after cancellation; add-on subscription still billed
relatedSnapshot.description:
Customer requests cancellation of his Acquisity subscription and a refund. Requester (internal) confirmed refund across the board because the customer says he is not using the account.

Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

Conversation context (bounded): contact Name 14 (<email>), no company, workspace "Name 14' Workspace". Only substantive message, 2026-10-02 13:53:13 UTC: "I WANT TO CANCEL THE PROGRAM. I'M NOT USING IT. I CANCELED AND YOUR STILL CHARGING ME. I WANT TO CANCEL AND MY MONEY RETURNED ASAP". No prior approval or promise exists anywhere in the conversation.

Testable claim: the customer cancelled his Pro plan on 2026-09-29 and a $185.00 Pro charge plus a $24.00 add-on charge were still collected afterwards, while the separately-billed inbox and domain add-ons remain live and scheduled to renew on 2026-10-29.

Finding summary:

* Pro ($185/mo) was set to cancel at period end. The cancellation was recorded 2026-09-29 20:14:48 UTC, about 65 minutes after that period's $185 invoice had already been generated (2026-09-29 19:09:47). Stripe collected the $185 on 2026-10-02 11:11:18, after the cancellation. Pro will not renew again.
* The inbox and domain add-ons are a separate subscription that cancelling Pro does not touch. It is still active, was never cancelled, and renews 2026-10-29 at $24.00/month for 3 inboxes plus an annual domain. This is the recurring charge the customer is right about.
* Collected and unrefunded in total: $690.00 across seven charges from 2026-07-20 to 2026-10-02. One earlier $42.00 bundle charge was already refunded in full on 2026-07-29.
* The July $42 pair is not a double charge: that first subscription was cancelled and refunded the same day.
* Named contradiction to the refund rationale: production and provider data show the account was set up and used, not idle. The workspace holds 5,410 leads, 2 campaigns (1 active), a registered domain <domain>, 3 provisioned and connected inboxes, and 5,410 product credits consumed. The matching Company One workspace holds 3 sending accounts and 2 campaigns.

Exposure and proposed human action: a human decides and executes the refund of up to $690.00 of collected charges and cancels the still-live inbox/domain add-on subscription so it cannot renew on 2026-10-29. No money has been moved.
